verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents its own Windows native engine built on C++ and Vulkan (edge0-gh-18), so a Vulkan inference path exists and by its nature would not depend on ROCm. However, the evidence is a single one-line mention: it never names AMD GPUs, never states that ROCm is unnecessary, and gives no performance figures. Vulkan also appears only on Windows, with CUDA as a reserved slot and no ROCm or Linux Vulkan path described. Missing for 10: explicit AMD GPU support, documentation of the Vulkan backend, a stated no-ROCm requirement, Vulkan acceleration benchmarks, Linux Vulkan support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
